utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Mara, have you heard anything more about that repair drive? I'm still not sure what to make of it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, I just heard it's been moved to Sunday at the community center. Are you still planning to help out?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not sure yet, honestly. Kira mentioned some shady stuff, so I'm a bit wary. What did you hear?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Vik! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? It's at the community center on Maple Street – you should totally come!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, I've been asking folks about the exact time — I'll let you know once I find out!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, it's at 10 AM sharp! I already told Sam and Opal—just spread the word, and I'll see you there!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, Gus. Any updates on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got a truck full of tools and spare parts if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That's great, Gus! Thanks for bringing all that. Any word on when we're starting?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's to fix broken household items. Collection is Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, right, fixing household items – I've got it now! Thanks, Leo. Sunday, you say? I'll mark my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good, thanks Oren. See you Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure about this repair drive? I've heard some shady things about those.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Shady things? Can you tell me more about what you've heard? I want to make sure I understand correctly.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I've heard they charge hidden fees and sometimes don't even fix things properly.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Cleo, are you planning to help with the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, I'm helping with supplies. I was actually going to ask you about paint and brushes—do we have enough?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I'm not sure about the paint and brushes—I've been focused on the drop-off logistics. Maybe we can check the supply list together?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, let me know what you find.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Right, the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center from 9 to 3. I can send you the sign-up list if you're interested.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, send me the list. I can help out for a couple hours in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Just a heads up, the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center. I hope that still works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, Sunday? I thought it was Saturday. I'll have to rearrange my schedule, but I'll make it work.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, thanks Bo, I appreciate you being flexible. I was worried the change might cause issues.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Ira, need any help with the repair drive? I've got some tools and I'm free this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Sam! I appreciate the offer. Things have been a bit slow, but extra hands would be great.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great! I heard from Bo you might be short on paint and brushes—I can pick some up if you need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Eli, I heard the repair drive got moved to Sunday. Is that right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sunday? I thought it was Saturday. Can you confirm the exact time and what we're supposed to bring?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, Pia told me it's at the community center on Sunday. Not sure about the time or what to bring though.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Sorry, I've been all over the place lately. Did we set a time for that?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No, we haven't set a time yet. Maybe we can decide on one this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: This weekend sounds good. Let's aim for Saturday afternoon? I'll try to remember to bring my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rosa, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Actually, Tess, the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I didn't know that! Thanks for letting me know, Rosa. I'll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Vik, I'm checking the supply list for the repair drive. Do you know if we have enough paint and brushes?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I'm not sure about the supplies, Cleo. I've been asking around for the time, but I can check with Dane or Jules about paint and brushes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be great, Vik. I want to make sure we have enough for everyone who needs them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I think it's something at the community center, but I'm not sure what exactly they're fixing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard Faye say she'll be at the community center from 9 to noon to accept donations for it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, 9 to noon? I knew that. Wait, is that today or tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, glad you're here. We're short on paint and brushes for the repair drive—can you spare any?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I have a few cans and brushes in my garage. I'll grab them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks Leo! That'll really help us out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Eli, you hear about the repair drive? Need any help?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I appreciate the offer, Sam. Do you happen to know the exact schedule and what they'd like me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Not sure of the exact schedule, but I heard Cleo's worried about paint and brushes. Maybe check with her?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Hana, have you heard anything about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hmm, I've heard it might be for playground equipment, but I'm not entirely sure. Do you know more?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Actually, I heard from Mina that they're fixing small appliances, not playground stuff. So bring anything that needs a repair.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Mina, I'm handling the morning drop-off for the repair drive this Saturday from 9 to noon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Actually, I heard it's been moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh really? I thought it was still on Saturday. Are you sure about Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, sorry I'm late. What's the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's still on for Saturday at the community center, but Ira mentioned it's been slow. Might need more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, thanks Opal. I can help out for a few hours on Saturday—just let me know what time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Heard you're organizing a repair drive. I've got a truck full of tools if you need any.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure about this repair drive? I've heard some shady things about those.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Shady? I haven't heard anything like that. It's supposed to be a community event to help each other out. What did you hear?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Jules, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? It's at the community center on Maple Street, starting at 10 AM Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I've been telling everyone about it! Dane and Ira are coming too — should be a great turnout.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, glad to hear it! I've been telling everyone I see — the more, the merrier!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Tess, are we still on for tomorrow to update the flyers for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, Mara! Let's meet at 10 at my place—I just heard from Cleo we need to add a note about bringing paint and brushes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, I'll bring my own paint and brushes. See you at 10!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Rosa, the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center for the roof, right? I've finally got it straight!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Actually, Oren, it's been moved to Sunday at the community center, not Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sunday? Oh, right, thanks Rosa! I'll make a note of it this time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Uli, do you know what the repair drive is actually for? I keep hearing about it but no one's explained yet.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's for the community center roof — replacing the shingles and fixing some beams.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Ah, that makes sense. Is Sam the one organizing it?
